summary: Lookout listed in Calloway County, Kentucky, on the Forest Lookouts index; no other source found describes the tower.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts page is for Kirksey
Forest Lookouts page gives the county as Calloway

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Forest Lookouts page carries only the name and county. TopoZone's Calloway County tower list (https://www.topozone.com/kentucky/calloway-ky/tower/) has no entries at all, so it gives no second source. Two searches and about four page reads found nothing on construction, design, staffing, status or access. Not on the NHLR or FFLOS Kentucky lists (checked 2026-10-21). The record's point (36.6574, -88.4055) came from the record; no text on the page gives coordinates, so it is unchecked. Story is about 30 words, far below the 120-word floor, on purpose. Editor should decide whether this stays as a stub or is hidden until a source turns up.
